lines.text: Hello friends, it's Milo, come with me!
Let's go to the sunny savanna, whee!
Big and small, let's meet them all!
I'm a lion, look at my mane!
I live with my family, a pride!
Roar like a lion, everybody, roar!
Did you know? Lions live together in a big family group, called a pride!
I'm an elephant, big and gray,
My trunk can smell and drink all day!
Toot like an elephant, toot toot toot!
Elephants use their long trunks to smell, and to drink water!
Big and small, let's meet them all!
I'm a giraffe, so tall, so tall!
Stretch up high and munch, munch, munch!
Giraffes are the tallest animals in the whole wide world!
Stomp, stomp, stomp like an elephant!
Stretch up high like a tall giraffe!
Swish your tail like a zebra, swish!
Now clap, clap, clap and jump, jump, jump!
I'm a zebra, black and white,
My stripes are special, just for me!
Gallop like a zebra, hee-haw, hee!
Every zebra has its very own stripes. No two zebras are the same!
Big and small, let's meet them all!
I'm a hippo, round and wide,
I splash in water to stay cool!
Splash like a hippo, splash, splash, splash!
Hippos spend the hot day in the water, to stay nice and cool!
Big and small, let's meet them all!
Big and small, let's meet them all!
Bye bye, friends, see you soon!
